subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should this reaction-specific issue wait for live current-main Slack Socket Mode envelope proof before any code fix is promoted?
rationale: The code already has handler-level support and the prior routing fix shipped, so the remaining failure could be upstream delivery, account filtering, or authorization; choosing a fix without live proof would be guesswork.

options.title: Require live trace first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for or run a redacted current-main multi-account Slack reaction trace before assigning a code fix.

options.title: Pair with socket liveness work
options.body: Treat this as potentially related to the broader Slack Socket Mode liveness investigation, while preserving this issue as the reaction-specific evidence thread.

options.title: Attempt a speculative instrumentation PR
options.body: Add narrowly scoped diagnostics around reaction envelope receipt and mismatch drops, but do not claim it fixes delivery without live proof.

recommendation.title: Require live trace first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for or run a redacted current-main multi-account Slack reaction trace before assigning a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this owner candidate to Slack monitor filtering and system-event authorization boundaries that decide where live proof should be captured.
